title: Content Writer
description:
Write crisp, engaging, and informative short-form content (100300 words) for social media posts, captions, reels, Twitter, emailers, WhatsApp campaigns, etc. Develop innovative headlines, taglines, and calls-to-action for marketing materials Develop short articles, alerts, and notifications on stock market news, stock tips, budget updates, IPOs, results, etc. Edit and proofread content to ensure clarity, accuracy, and grammatical correctness Research industry trends and integrate findings into content to ensure relevance and engagement Create content around equity, derivatives, mutual funds, SIPs, demat accounts, and more. Use SEO best practices to write optimized content for higher visibility on digital platforms. Double-check content for factual accuracy, especially where financial figures or stock recommendations are included. Stay updated with market trends, SEBI announcements, and finance-related current affairs to create timely, relevant content. Brainstorm and write scripts for finance-based reels, video bytes, and daily market commentary. Collaborate with research analysts and marketing teams to develop timely, relevant content.

Key Skills: SEO Writing,Content Creation,Proof Reading,Content Writing,Copy Writing,Blogs,Blog Writing,Script Writing
